answer: Deposits are visible in jade, and opal reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 17% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 66 aliases, and each one needs its own funded timber account. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 8 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
